links.outcome: Answer accuracy and unsupported content with versus without retrieval grounding on medical QA benchmarks
links.effect: Fine-tuned LLaMA 2 with RAG reached 71.8% accuracy on PubMedQA vs 55.4% zero-shot baseline; grounding reduced unsupported content by approximately 60%.
links.quote: We also detail the system design and fine-tuning methodology, demonstrating that grounding answers in retrieved evidence reduces unsupported content by approximately 60%.

unlisted_practices: Parameter-efficient LoRA fine-tuning of open-source LLMs for medical domain specialization

screen.reason: Evaluates adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounding to LLMs compared to LLMs alone to reduce hallucinations on medical QA benchmarks.
